purpose: Locked research-only regression stress test; never training or calibration input
provenance: AI-authored individually composed cases, not human annotations or private user messages
independence: Each row is a separate fictional session; recent messages belong only to that row. No corpus.py template generation.
created_after: run-v3-fixed training/calibration and first synthetic evaluation
label_policy: reply protects a current conversational request/emotion/important share; defer keeps an incomplete expression open; context_only is completed acknowledgement/withdrawal/closure. Ordinary shares are subjective fixtures, not ground truth about real users.
usage_limitations: Small AI-authored Chinese challenge set, not a human-labelled generalization benchmark
Protected and silent cohorts are below production gate sample minima; no release-gate pass is inferred
Results may guide future regression review but v1 stays frozen; changing it requires a new dataset version
